title: System Log: Full Isolation of SCADA Core

lines.msg: Isolation protocol initiated: MBW-SCADA-SRV01 to MBW-BKP-01 SMB link terminated
Firewall rule FW-R-17 (SMB from MBW-EWS-01 to MBW-BKP-01) disabled
Firewall rule FW-R-22 (outbound HTTPS from MBW-HMI-02 to DosaTech relay) isolated; source node blocked
DosaTech ScreenBridge agent still active on MBW-HMI-02 (10.72.10.22); session not terminated
Confirmed: DosaTech ScreenBridge agent remains active on MBW-HMI-02; no session end signal received
Full network isolation complete. Control network (zone 1) isolated from business LAN. No further data flows to or from MBW-BKP-01 or business-side systems.
All HMI and PLC communication to business systems blocked. No outbound paths remain.
System state: Isolated. No further remote access possible from business LAN. Forensic handover pending.
Isolation confirmed by SCADA / IT Security Manager (Priya Nandakumar) via MBW-JUMP-01 (10.72.10.100).
Forensic chain-of-custody form SEC-4-2026-1022-082212 activated. All logs retained on MBW-SCADA-SRV01.
MBW-SCADA-SRV01 status: Isolated, No Remote Access, Locked
System log export completed. File: /var/log/scada-isolation-20261022-102417.log

instructorNote: This confirms the network is isolated but the DosaTech agent remains active. The technical team must now verify that no further session can be initiated and that the forensic handover is complete before any action on the HMI.
